content.text: United States Consumer Price Index (CPI) Summary Forecast Calendar Alerts Download Download Data Excel Add-in API Access Consumer Price Index CPI in the United States increased to 330.21 points in March from 326.79 points in February of 2026. Consumer Price Index CPI in the United States averaged 128.47 points from 1950 until 2026, reaching an all time high of 330.21 points in March of 2026 and a record low of 23.50 points in February of 1950. source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Consumer Price Index CPI in the United States is expected to be 333.85 points by the end of this quarter, according to Trading Economics global macro models and analysts expectations.
